content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 identifies this service as bundled into another paid service and not separately payable; the case provides no coding error or evidence supporting an exception to that determination. Authorization is not required, and neither a necessity appeal nor peer-to-peer review has a supported basis to overturn the bundling denial. This contractual adjustment cannot be transferred to the patient merely because a deductible remains, and there is no secondary payer or other collectible balance identified.","action":"write_off"}
